project.title: Metagenomic profiling of nitrogen, phosphorus, and carbon cycling genes across anaerobic-anoxic-oxic tanks of a municipal wastewater treatment plant
project.description: This project characterizes the functional gene repertoires of nitrogen, phosphorus, and carbon cycling in the activated sludge microbial communities of a full-scale anaerobic-anoxic-oxic (AAO) municipal wastewater treatment plant. Twenty-seven metagenomes were generated from the anaerobic, anoxic, and oxic tanks and annotated against NCycDB, PCycDB, and CAZy to reveal how metabolic functions are partitioned along the redox gradient.
